name: Doug Ball
fact: Ball was a Louisville junior and a speech major in 1981-82. He played Mahatma Gandhi in the 'meeting of the minds' staged for Dr James T. Baker's Honors History 120 class, telling the Talisman he had studied for four hours because he knew nothing about Gandhi, and that he was more nervous about how he looked than about the acting. The volume indexes him as Douglas Clair Ball. He also lost the 1982 race for administrative vice president to Jack Smith, a Prospect junior.

src.label: 1982 Talisman, p. 109, Jane Reid, 'Face to face'; p. 371 index; p. 65 election report

name: John Holland
fact: Holland was in Associated Student Government two years before he became public relations vice president: the 1982 Talisman's Associated Student Government group photograph names him in its third row. The volumes index him as John M. Holland. By 1984-85 he was a Louisville senior and co-chairman of the ASG book exchange committee.

src.label: 1982 Talisman, p. 241, Associated Student Government group photograph; 1985 Talisman, p. 202, book exchange report

name: Todd Wallace
fact: Wallace was a Cadiz senior in 1984-85 and helped run Greek Week 1985, telling the Talisman the aim was to show that the greek system could do good things for the community and the university. The 1985 volume indexes him as Todd David Wallace, which distinguishes him from the Michael Todd Wallace indexed in the 1984 volume.

src.label: 1985 Talisman, p. 79, 'Nine days make a greek weak'; p. 378 index

name: Donna Holloway
fact: Holloway was from Owensboro and was a sophomore in 1984-85, the year she first ran for Associated Student Government office. The 1985 volume indexes her as Donna Ann Holloway. She does not appear anywhere in the 1986 or 1987 Talisman.

src.label: 1985 Talisman, p. 340, sophomore portraits; p. 373 index

name: Allan Kujala
fact: The 1984 Talisman indexes him as Allan Toivo Kujala and puts him on three organization pages, 238, 258 and 268, but on no class portrait page. Page 238 is the Associated Student Government spread, which also carries Donna Holloway and Stanley Reagan.

name: Chris Watkins
fact: Watkins wrote for the Talisman as well as serving in Congress: a photo essay in the 1986 volume carries his byline, and he wrote the greek sports story in the 1987 volume. Neither volume indexes him, so the bylines are the only trace.

src.label: 1986 Talisman, p. 31, 'Love on Campus'; 1987 Talisman, p. 194

name: Bill Parsons
fact: Parsons wrote for the 1989 Talisman's sports section, sharing a byline on a swimming feature. The volume indexes him only as Parsons, William 332, the page that story sits on.

name: John Seiber
fact: Seiber was a Spirit Master in 1989-90 and stands third from the left in the back row of the group photograph, between C. Jill Miller and Daryl Pepper. He was a Hendersonville, Tennessee sophomore that year and was quoted in the volume on Campus Crusade for Christ's Christmas conference in Atlanta and its jail ministry.

src.label: 1990 Talisman, p. 166, Spirit Masters group photograph, and p. 154

name: Daryl Pepper
fact: Pepper was a Spirit Master in 1989-90 and stands fourth from the left in the back row of the group photograph, between John M. Seiber and G. Charles Patton. It is the only page of the volume the index gives him.

src.label: 1990 Talisman, p. 166, Spirit Masters group photograph

name: Karl Miller
fact: Miller was treasurer of Western's chapter of the Public Relations Students Society of America in 1990-91, under president Beth Struck and vice president Jeff Polson, and stands third of five in the back row of the chapter's group photograph. Those two pages are the only ones the 1991 index gives him, and neither ties him to student government.

src.label: 1991 Talisman, pp. 162 and 165, Public Relations Students Society of America

name: Shannon Montgomery
fact: The 1990 Talisman index gives her one page, 162, the Associated Student Government spread. She is not in the 1991 volume at all.

name: Bill Engle
fact: The 1990 Talisman indexes him as Engle, William H. and gives him one page, 162, the Associated Student Government spread.

name: Drew DeLozier
fact: DeLozier was a Louisville junior and chairman of the Rules and Elections Committee during the 1988 Associated Student Government presidential election, the one where seven candidates were certified after a dispute over whether Shannon Ragland's early signs were campaign material. The 1988 Talisman gives him one page, 38, which is that election report, and it carries no photograph of him.

src.label: 1988 Talisman, pp. 38-39, 'Policy of politics'; p. 365 index

name: Connie Hoffmann
fact: The 1985 Talisman index appears to carry her as Hoffman, Cornelia 264, between Hofelder and Hobson. The rendering of the double f is not certain and page 264 is an organization page, not a class portrait, so this is a lead rather than a fact.

name: Julie Lippert
fact: The 1985 Talisman indexes her as Lippert, Julie Ellen and gives her pages 205 and 264, both organization pages. She sat for no class portrait in that volume.
